vs-series/vs321.note: 0x20 0xCE: ts + mode(0: people count u16 / 1: region mask u16 + occupancy bits u16).

Line 1 also mapped to people_*.

uc-series/uc300.note: 0x20 0xDC I/O record (ts + u16 channel mask + per-channel data) -> JS 'channel_history'; 0x20 0xDD Modbus record (ts + u32 mask + 5 B per channel) -> JS 'modbus_history'. Official decoder puts Modbus coil values outside the record (bug); we keep them in the record. Custom text channel (48 B) skipped. No encoder commands.

uc-series/uc501.note: 0x20 0xDC (22 B): ts + 2 x (gpio type + u32) + 2 x analog i32/1000; 0x20 0xDD: ts + u16 mask + 5 B per channel (u32 or float); 0x20 0xE0 SDI-12 text skipped. Fetch always uses fd6c (start only -> end 0). Official readUInt32LE is signed (we return unsigned).

uc-series/uc502.note: 0x20 0xDC (22 B): ts + 2 x (gpio type + u32) + 2 x analog i32/1000; 0x20 0xDD: ts + u16 mask + 5 B per channel (u32 or float); 0x20 0xE0 SDI-12 text skipped. Fetch always uses fd6c (start only -> end 0). Official readUInt32LE is signed (we return unsigned).

uc-series/uc511.note: 0x20 0xCE (9 B): ts + flags (b0 valve, b1 mode counter, b2 gpio, b4 valve index) + pulse u32; 0x21 0xCE (6 B): ts + pipe pressure u16 kPa. Fetch always fd6c. clear_history is ff27ff here.

uc-series/uc512.note: 0x20 0xCE (9 B): ts + flags (b0 valve, b1 mode counter, b2 gpio, b4 valve index) + pulse u32; 0x21 0xCE (6 B): ts + pipe pressure u16 kPa. Fetch always fd6c. clear_history is ff27ff here.

uc-series/uc100.note: 0x20 0xCE: ts + chn + data_def (sign b7, type b2-6, read ok b1) + 4 B value; read failures and 0x20 0xCD custom-message history are skipped. Undefined types 26-31: official decoder skips only 6 B (we skip the full 10 B).

uc-series/uc100-v2.note: 0x21 0xCE (23 B): ts + chn + def u16 (sign b15, type b9-14, read ok b8, reg count b6-7, alarm b4-5) + 2 x 8 B values. No stop_transmit in official encoder. Official readDoubleLE is wrong when bit 31 of the low word is set (we use struct). retransmit also via f90d<en><interval u16>.

vs-series/vs373.note: History = stored alarm events (0x20 0xCE: ts + alarm_id u16 + type + status + region), same fields as live 'events' entries (alarm_type/status are text). No history_enable command; fetch always uses fd6c (start only -> end 0).

wt-series/wt102.note: Command format: 0xED type(1) ts u32 opens a record; the following commands (same as live) until the next 0xED are its values (numeric/bool live keys kept). retransmission interval c502 u16 s, retrieval interval c503 u16 s.

wt-series/wt201.note: official encoder has the fd6b/fd6c choice inverted (start+end gives fd6b start only, start only gives fd6c start 00000000); send fd6c start end for a range, fd6b start for 'since start'. 0x20 0xCE: ts + 2 packed u16 (fan/system/temperature 11 bit, mode/status/target 11 bit; value/10-100 °C).

wt-series/wt201-v2.note: 0x20 0xCE (13 B): ts + packed u16 + target i16/10 + target_2 i16/10 (0xFFFF = none) + temperature i16/10 + humidity u8/2. Official encoder has no fetch/stop/clear commands (WT201 v1 uses fd6c/fd6b/fd6dff; unverified for v2).

wt-series/wt211.note: 0x20 0xCE (13 B): ts + packed u16 + target i16/10 + target_2 i16/10 (0xFFFF = none) + temperature i16/10 + humidity u8/2. Official encoder has no fetch/stop/clear commands (WT201 v1 uses fd6c/fd6b/fd6dff; unverified for v2).
